title: The Wet Letter
style: photoreal cinematic still, Tamil family drama, natural morning window light, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens, warm muted colour grade, realistic skin texture, no text, no watermark
setting: a modest middle-class Chennai kitchen: grey granite counter, steel sink, stacked stainless-steel vessels, a two-burner gas stove, light-green painted walls, a barred window with morning sun

characters.nila: Nila, a 21-year-old Tamil woman, slim, warm brown skin, long black hair in a single loose braid, small black bindi, simple faded pink cotton churidar with a cream dupatta, thin gold chain, gentle tired face, kind dark eyes
characters.latha: Latha, a 48-year-old Tamil woman, stern face, sharp eyebrows, large red kumkum bindi, hair in a tight bun with jasmine flowers, dark green silk saree with a gold zari border, heavy gold necklace and bangles

shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of the kitchen. Latha stands in the kitchen doorway on the left, pointing angrily at the sink. Nila stands at the sink on the right in three-quarter back view, turning her head toward Latha, hands wet. Piles of unwashed steel vessels on the counter.
shots.video_prompt: Latha steps forward from the doorway and jabs her finger toward the sink; Nila flinches and turns her head toward her. Slow push-in. Sunlight dust in the air.

shots.speaker: latha
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of Latha facing camera slightly off-centre, scolding, mouth slightly open mid-sentence, eyebrows raised in anger, one hand raised. Over-the-shoulder framing: Nila's back, braid and pink churidar shoulder with cream dupatta blurred in the left foreground. Kitchen background soft.
shots.video_prompt: Latha scolds angrily, head shaking slightly, hand gesturing. Static camera.

shots.speaker: nila
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of Nila facing camera slightly off-centre, eyes glistening with held-back tears, holding a wet steel vessel against her chest, lips parted as she replies softly. Window light on her face, sink behind her.
shots.video_prompt: Nila answers softly, lowering her eyes, a tear forming. Very slow push-in.

shots.image_prompt: Close-up insert of Nila's hands scrubbing a stainless-steel pot under a running tap in the steel sink. On the wet counter beside the sink lies an opened envelope with a blue college crest, its paper soaked and wrinkled by the splashing water. Her pink sleeve and thin bangle visible.
shots.video_prompt: Hands scrub the pot under running water; water splashes onto the soaked envelope; a single tear drop falls into frame and lands on the envelope. Static macro shot.

l1.speaker: latha
l1.english: Nila! You still haven't washed the vessels?

l2.speaker: nila
l2.english: I'm washing them right now, Chithi…
